study.question: Does retaining target-field-match x historical-feedback co-occurrence before pooling improve the compressed unified readout beyond exact marginal counts and equal added capacity? Observed limitation: g2-r0015-task_exact/centroid/union click AUCs are0.6634535565/0.6633887529/0.6634628103; exact sums do not beat union at this single seed. Auxiliary AUCs in the union parent are0.7468709341/0.7725377747/0.7434408768 versus DIN0.8490697020/0.8648974929/0.8701822751. Even exact task moments remain far below DIN auxiliaries. This is a multi-task tradeoff, not uniform improvement. Earlier target-match stratification match20 did not beat rotated20 or uniform20; exact counts in g2-r0006-exact_blocked improved auxiliary metrics relative to context_only but not click. Private residual capacity, full100 scoring and target-conditioned20 slots were unsuccessful alternatives, so more event capacity or more learned scoring is not presumed beneficial. Age/behavior readout contrasts in r0013-r0014 indicate information retention matters conditionally. No execution failures appear in the supplied trajectory index; negative and abandoned directions remain evidence, not refutations of all implementations.
study.hypothesis: Averaging item embeddings separately from feedback membership can discard their within-history association even when task-specific centroids add little. An inexpensive pre-pooling count sketch can preserve whether a past event matching a current target field also had each historical feedback, conditional on old versus last-ten position. This may support task readouts without adding learned event scores. The causal mechanism under test is information in joint co-occurrence beyond both marginals; efficacy and originality are unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Append four identical32-unit residual heads receiving context, target, and an80-number descriptor. For each absolute age [0,90) and [90,100), compute valid population, four canonical historical task counts (is_click/cart/fav/buy), and seven match counts: equality of the six actual item fields plus categoryANDbrand, excluding zero and masked IDs. These24 marginal coordinates are shared across cells. The remaining56 coordinates are four tasks x seven match indicators x two ages: aligned joint counts, products of task/match marginals divided by valid age population, or joint counts after cyclically shifting all four task memberships together within each age. All counts are FP32 and divided by100, retaining overlaps; all alternatives execute in every cell. The shift respects valid positions and preserves age/task marginals and overlap structure. Readout remains user/context/target-conditioned; auxiliary inputs obey inherited gradient gates. Extra heads start at zero so initial predictions reproduce parent. No raw timestamps, present labels, sample IDs, new masks, extra learned event scoring or training hooks. Positive missing/OOV IDs can alias and are a limitation. The descriptor is a restricted lossy summary, not sufficient for arbitrary sequence prediction. No claim of newness beyond the inspected implementations.
predictions: Joint_counts will exceed marginal_counts and shifted_counts on validation click AUC if aligned co-occurrence retains useful information beyond common marginals. Predeclared practical shortlist margin is0.0002 against each control; this is a decision threshold, not significance.
Auxiliary AUCs may recover beyond union parent, particularly category/brand-associated outcomes; that is a separate secondary result and cannot substitute for primary click selection.

All cells have identical parameter counts and new initial heads, first24 descriptor coordinates, scorer population and inherited buffers at identical weights; zero-output initialization reproduces parent.

The extra counting work has no learned event scorer and a small state relative to full history activations, but measured latency/peak memory/wall cost can still worsen. Compare the measured quality-cost frontier to union parent and DIN; no efficiency conclusion from parameter count alone.
falsifiers: Joint does not improve on product-marginal and shifted controls at the practical click margin, or improvement is lost in later paired seeds/user-cluster intervals: no support for a primary joint-information benefit.

Only auxiliary metrics improve: record partial task benefit while the main objective remains unmet. If all cells similarly beat parent, common marginal information or capacity is the simpler explanation.

Aligned and shifted modes perform alike: event-alignment mechanism is unsupported, subject to shift retaining real correlation. Aligned greater than shifted alone cannot rule out placebo distribution damage.

Any masking, count, initialization, gradient-source, buffer or host interface prerequisite fails: classify as implementation failure, do not interpret as scientific refutation, preserve its cost and fix only within the admissible phase.
Quality gain consumes enough measured compute/memory/latency to remove the frontier advantage: do not claim reduced cost. Null r0015 content contrasts do not prove task identity irrelevant.
alternative_explanations: Extra dense capacity or common history/task/match counts may help; both replacement controls have identical heads, parameter counts and marginals.

Real-valued product marginals and integer joint counts differ in feature distribution and rank despite matching shapes/nominal capacity; cyclic joint control partly addresses but does not remove this.

One-rank shift can retain autocorrelation and usually preserves more structure than randomization, or can damage genuine position/action association; it is a deterministic negative control, not a statistical permutation test.

Current context/target embedding quality or task-loss interference can dominate; auxiliary gaps might stem from gradient blocking or score sharing rather than compression. Do not relax those gates in the current contrasts.

Single seed, one pass, many adaptive validation comparisons and rare auxiliary labels permit chance effects. Counts available under official_offline can exploit feedback not mature at production prediction time.
Whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots, OOV collisions and category/brand auxiliary-label construction limit production generalization. No claim of item-specific conversion prediction.
Existing exact-count trial r0006 may already contain related statistics; old source is unavailable and method originality remains unverified.
